name: @sqonde/knoten
description: Minimal React data-fetching hooks: useQuery, useMutation, invalidate.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=browser --outdir=dist --external react --external zustand && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.verify:dist: bun -e "const m = await import('./dist/index.js'); for (const n of ['useQuery','useMutation','invalidate']) if (typeof m[n] !== 'function') throw new Error('dist export missing or not a function: ' + n); console.log('dist exports OK');"
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run verify:dist
scripts.release:patch: bun pm version patch && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: bun pm version minor && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: bun pm version major && git push --follow-tags
